During the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|return]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] proposed [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]. Following the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|liberation of Coruscant]] and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]], Solo was promoted to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and Fel handed over the Head of State position to [[Vitor Reige]]. Several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] later, Solo and Fel were '''married''' aboard the [[Hapan]] [[Hapan Battle Dragon|Battle Dragon]] ''[[Dragon Queen II]]''.<ref name="Apocalypse" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jaina Solo and Jagged Fel's marriage appeared in the [[2012]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]'', the final book in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series. The marriage itself was not seen, as the novel ended right as Solo walked down the aisle.
